chapter: Union, publishers, race and Harlem nightlife
title: Armstrong swearing and his wife Alpha
summary: He heard Armstrong swear only a couple of times, and Alpha once threw coffee.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: No. I never heard him swear but once, twice. That was when he was going to meet his wife one night... The next time, he bought her some new luggage... The valet went to pull down one of the bags and he snagged it. I never heard nobody swear like that in my life. (LAUGHTER)

..... The stage manager - we just drove in, so he told Louis - Lou was swearing like mad - so he told Louis to shut up. Boy, you should have heard the names that Louis called him... When he get angry, don't bother him.
He did that morning. We came in - you know sometimes
he and I hang out like this. We had been out, you know, sporting around. It was too late for his wife. She threw a cup of coffee.
Which wife was it that you're speaking of? He was married three times. Which one?
Alpha. She died out in California.
